title: Student Debt: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
summary: John Oliver covers student debt and the for-profit colleges that push students into it, including Corinthian-style schools and ITT Tech. It is a segment from Last Week Tonight.
why: HN mostly references it in passing when student loans and predatory colleges come up, with one commenter recommending the veterans benefits section.
